content: # SendGrid — MCP server on mcp.ai > Connect your SendGrid account and use 364 tools for transactional email straight from your AI agent. Connect with your own API key. SendGrid is a cloud-based email delivery platform providing transactional and marketing email services, with APIs for integration, analytics, and scalability. By: mcp.ai · official Page: https://mcp.ai/sendgrid ## Connect (MCP protocol) Remote MCP endpoint (HTTP, streamable): https://api.mcp.ai/p_sendgrid?ms=1795427760000 Add it as a custom/remote MCP connector, then authenticate when prompted. ## Install in your AI client (step by step) Link to paste in any client: https://api.mcp.ai/p_sendgrid ### Claude 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. In Claude, Customize → Connectors → Add → Add custom connector: name SendGrid, paste the link and click Continue. Under Authentication, choose Sign in now and click Add. 3. The first time, Claude opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. Open: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors ### ChatGPT 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. In ChatGPT (web), Plugins → Add → Add custom MCP server: name SendGrid, paste the link, under Authentication choose OAuth or no authentication, check I understand, click Create as a plugin, then Sign in with SendGrid. 3. The first time, ChatGPT opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. Open: https://chatgpt.com/plugins ### Cursor 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. In Cursor, Settings → MCP → "Add new MCP server", paste the link and save. 3. The first time, Cursor opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. ### Claude Desktop 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. Added it in Claude? The connector lives in your account and shows up on Desktop. If not, Customize → Connectors → Add → Add custom connector, paste the link and choose Sign in now. 3. The first time, Claude opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. ### Manus 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. Paste the link into a Manus chat and ask it to connect the MCP server. 3. The first time, Manus opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. ### Agents 1. Copy the SendGrid link above (Copy button). 2. Paste the link into your MCP-compatible agent (remote HTTP server). 3. The first time, agent opens the mcp.ai sign-in: sign in with Google or email and click Allow. 4. When SendGrid needs your account, the AI sends you a link: click Connect SendGrid and authorize. 5. Done: just ask in the chat. ## REST API (no MCP client required) Every tool is also a REST endpoint, authed with a workspace API key.
